market_summary: During the London/NY Overlap, risk-off pressure dominates Gold and Bitcoin, both heavily extended below session Value Areas and VWAP, hovering near key support and Put Walls where chasing is penalized. EURUSD exhibits quiet drift toward local lows without volume conviction. In contrast, US100 printed a sharp volume-confirmed reclaim back above VWAP, EMA50, and its Value Area High into a positive gamma regime, offering a clear momentum long setup.

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (3938.58) and POC (3977.51). CVD is BEARISH (-9.83, slope -1.31), agreeing with the strong session downtrend. During LONDON_NY_OVERLAP, price broke beneath the EMA50 (3943.27) and VWAP (3952.84), extending past the -2 ATR lower band (3892.21). However, GEX shows NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING regime below Gamma Flip (3922.39), but price directly hit Put Wall #1 (3871.35) and Session Low (3866.09) without yellow RVOL confirmation on the immediate retest (RVOL 1.539). Selling directly into Put Wall #1 is prohibited, and buying counter-trend is low probability; thus HOLD is warranted.

Price is below VAL (1.10801) and POC (1.10928). CVD is NEUTRAL (-2,147 with negative slope -8209). Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is below downward-sloping VWAP (1.10864) and EMA50 (1.10882), stretching down near the lower ATR band (1.10716). RVOL is only 1.23 (no yellow spike), indicating lack of aggressive institutional selling at this breakdown. The market is pressing directly into S/R (1.10710) and Session Low (1.10662) without volume expansion, risking a mean-reversion trap. HOLD.

Price has broken out above VAH (28203.68) and POC (28115.45). CVD is NEUTRAL (-2.03) but cvd_slope is positive (+1.53). In LONDON_NY_OVERLAP, price made an aggressive V-shape reclaim above VWAP (28121.48) and EMA50 (28127.31) backed by an RVOL spike of 2.194 (yellow bar). GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING above Gamma Flip (28157.59). While Call Wall #1 sits overhead at 28424.24, there is ample room (~185 points) for momentum continuation upward towards the wall and Prev High (28596.50). Taking a BUY scalp on acceptance above local S/R 28209.17.
signals.level_event: acceptance above VAH and Gamma Flip

signals.rationale: Price is severely extended below VAL (72836.73) and POC (73512.29). CVD is BEARISH (-0.09, slope -0.02), agreeing with the heavy downtrend. In LONDON_NY_OVERLAP, price remains pinned far below VWAP (73173.73) and EMA50 (73044.51). The signal candle breached Session Low (71191.90) and is deep outside the lower ATR envelope (71830.04) with RVOL 1.696 (sub-2.0, no yellow spike on this bar after the initial flush). Given the severe ATR overextension and lack of fresh climax volume to support an immediate continuation entry, HOLD for a mean-reversion retest.
